delivery.outcome: Deliver issue134 bounded opt-in streaming calibration and fresh workload-bound quote ranking through protected OneDev and independent Validator.
nonGoals: No ordinary completion changes, provider/account configuration, cooldown reset, new credentials, package release, service restart or automatic paid sweeps.
No production p90 claim from tiny samples; no raw prompt, generated text, keys or provider error bodies in receipts.

architecture.decision: Use the existing approved OpenAI worker request validator and native catalog/health/usage boundaries. Isolate streaming measurement in an opt-in subprocess with wall-clock cancellation; reserve advertised worst-case probe cost before each dispatch and stop on missing accounting or any failed probe. Isolate existing mocked native-transport unit tests from host archive/telemetry I/O so caller deadline tests do not depend on PostgreSQL latency; separate integration tests retain persistence coverage.

dataChanges.description: Private fixed-workload operator probe reports owned by calibration. Existing cross-component usage schema and storage are unchanged.

architecture.rollback: Protected revert of the added modules; existing completion and journal formats remain unchanged.

validation.evidence: Offline SSE, budget, health, cancellation, no-network dry-run and metric freshness/profile tests; full stack then independent exact-head publication.
